thread: maria (Design): quick accessibility sweep request — Session Recordings dashboard legend: the color swatches seem low contrast in dark theme and there's no visible focus outline when tabbing the legend toggles. can someone do a keyboard + screen reader pass? alex (Eng): noted. i can reproduce the missing focus ring. when i tab to the legend items the outline is 0.5px and almost invisible. probable CSS specificity issue. leo (Accessibility): dropping some quick checks: contrast for the legend text `#8a8f98` on background `#111218` is around 3.6:1 — fails AA for normal text. swatches (pure color chips) are fine for color vision but we need labels with >=4.5:1 or add a meet-point marker. also screen reader only content needs `aria-checked` on toggles. jamal (PM): impact note — product analytics team uses legend heavily to toggle segments during demos. if keyboard users can't see focus we should fix before next release (Wed). alex (Eng): quick patch idea: add a 2px focus outline with `outline-offset: 2px` and bump label color to `#c9ced6`. sample CSS: ```css .legend-toggle:focus { outline: 2px solid #a3b0c6; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; } .legend-label { color: #c9ced6; } ``` maria (Design): that color looks OK to me but let's validate contrast in both themes. also maybe a subtle box-shadow for focus so it doesn't feel harsh. leo (Accessibility): agree on validating both light/dark. two additional a11y items: 1) keyboard order — tab lands on legend toggles after timeline controls, which is fine, but we should add `role="group" aria-label="legend filters"` to the container so screen readers announce grouping. 2) announce state changes: when a legend toggle hides a series, SR should hear "Series name hidden" — can add `aria-live="polite"` region updates. alex (Eng): re: announce state changes — i can toggle a visually-hidden live region and push `"{seriesName} hidden"` text. simple impl: ```html ``` leo (Accessibility): perfect. make sure to avoid repetitive announcements on rapid toggles (debounce 200ms). also prefer `aria-pressed` on the toggle buttons vs `aria-checked` for accessibility semantics. a11y-bot: contrast-check: legend labels (current) => FAIL (3.6:1). suggested minimum label color: `#c9ced6` => PASS (4.6:1) on background `#111218`. automated keyboard-focus check: focus outline width < 2px => issue flagged. maria (Design): tiny copy tweak: change "Hide series" tooltip to "Hide series from chart (visible to keyboard users)"? that's a mouthful — maybe just "Hide series" is fine but ensure tooltip has `aria-hidden` for SR not to duplicate. thoughts? leo (Accessibility): tooltip duplication is common. best practice: use `aria-describedby` pointing to the tooltip only when visible; otherwise SR should rely on the button label + `aria-pressed` state. keep tooltip text short. jamal (PM): new acceptance criteria for this ticket: 1) legend text >= 4.5:1 dark and light, 2) keyboard focus visible and 2px min, 3) `aria-pressed` on toggles, 4) live region announces changes (debounced). target: merge by Tue EOD. alex (Eng): i'll push a small PR with CSS + SR changes and include screenshots and axe report. will flag for review when ready. maria (Design): thanks team — appreciate quick turnaround :sparkles: leo (Accessibility): i'll do a follow-up SR sanity check once PR is up. alex (Eng): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/webapp/pull/4298 (draft). includes CSS + role updates + debounce. notes in PR about tooltip handling. maria (Design): awesome. leaving a small design nit on the PR for hover state contrast but that's optional for this patch. a11y-bot: deployment-check: staged to qa, automated tests passed (contrast + keyboard focus), manual SR check pending.
